notes: No command channel found for the Cubic Odyssey Dedicated Server (Steam app 3858450, listed as a Tool named "Cubic Odyssey Dedicated Server (Beta Version)"; the game itself is app 3400000). The server is configured only by config/server_config.txt (serverName, serverPassword, maxPlayers, galaxySeed, allowRelaying, privateServer, startingPort/endingPort, enableLogging, enableCrashDumps) and start parameters such as -Port, -MaxPort, -MaxNumPlayers, -Password, -Gamemode; its console window only prints status and the DS-XXXXXX lobby code players connect with. Nothing in the developer's dedicated-server announcements, the two long community setup threads, the WindowsGSM plugin (which implements no query or RCON path), or the hosting-panel knowledge bases documents RCON, a REST/HTTP admin API, or typed console commands. One forum poster asserts a dedicated-server owner 'can replace the stolen items and ban them', but gives no mechanism and no command text; treat that as an unsupported claim rather than evidence of a ban command. Config changes need a restart (one thread claims a SteamCMD reinstall is needed for them to take). Confidence is low on purpose: the authoritative documents are help/server_manual.txt and help/server_help.txt inside the server install, which are not published online and could not be read remotely - re-check this file against them before relying on it. The server app has been on Steam as a beta tool since 30 July 2025 and was announced to players on 13 October 2025, so admin tooling is an obvious gap the developer may fill; re-check after game updates.
